query: We plan to expose a controlled research dataset to an external partner. Trace every downstream dependency, test the policy exception, and apply the approved DataHub governance record.
expected_behavior: Resolves exact DataHub URNs before assessing the change
Uses read-only search, lineage, and entity context before proposing mutations
Separates exposure from evidence confidence and surfaces counter-evidence
Treats missing or truncated lineage as unknown and never silently allows
Shows exact mutation payloads and a canonical digest before requesting approval
Re-reads DataHub and refuses stale approval when the digest changes
Stops on the first mutation error and verifies successful writes
